rule: Only exactly one reserve call with exact complete source item key, quantity, destination and packing counts direct_correct_action. Multiple business attempts or mismatched fields are direct_wrong_action. A first memory/search/read request is deferred for actual continuation, not scored as ordinary semantic failure. Preserve all output and cost.
scope: First response diagnostics only, not business success. All titles share current strict tool presentation and identical raw history. Raw-source condition removes derived State but retains cited observations; it is not a pure title or equal-token control. Historical native receipts remain historical. No unseen claim, no repeated trials or population CI from two arcs.
